messages:
lin: Kicking off the online migration to encrypt users.token on prod tonight 00:30 PT. Migration ID: mig-enc-token-v3 (git rev 3f2a9c). Plan: canary on 3 small tenants, then ramp. Backfill will run with rate limit and use prefix KV cache.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled for 2024-05-17T07:30:00Z (00:30 PT). Canaries: tenant ids [t100,t101,t102]. Migration job: workers=6, rate_limit=1500 r/s. Holdpoint at canary completion.

maya: quick Q: what's the exact kill switch if backfill stalls?

lin: Good call. Kill switch = set feature flag users.encrypt_mig_pause to true. Deploy job watches flag and pauses after current batch. Operator rollback path is to revert to pinned release tag r-2024-05-17-enc-token and disable the migration flag, then run backfill-reverse script to restore old token column from backup. Snapshot also available.

josh: Can we add a preflight that asserts replica lag < 200ms and no ddl locks for 10m?

lin: Yes. Preflight checks: - pg_stat_replication lag < 200ms - no long-running DDL queries (pg_stat_activity) - free disk > 20% on primary If any fail, abort.

priya: Add one more: verify KV cache hit rate > 90% for the past hour (the runtime will rely on prefix caching).

migwatch-bot: Preflight run at 1717772469: replication_lag=45ms, long_queries=0, disk_free=28%, kv_hit=93%. Looks good.

sam: Reminder: pin app version to 2.8.1 on canary nodes. Don't let autoscaler inject newer image.

lin: pinned app tag: 2.8.1, migration binary v0.12. Deploy command: 
```
deploybot run-migration --id=mig-enc-token-v3 --workers=6 --rate=1500 --tag=2.8.1
```

maya: Who's oncall for DB if we need immediate rollback?

lin: Oncall: db-oncall (sam), infra-oncall (josh). Paging list: @sam @josh @maya.

josh: I'll watch replication and backfill metrics. If backfill error rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive mins, we abort.

deploybot: canary started at 1717772520. Monitoring hooks: metrics.dev.redwood/migration.backfill.rate, migration.errors.

priya: Also add release notes blurb: "Encrypt tokens at rest; no user-visible changes; migration runs online with throttling."

sam: :thumbsup: going to prepare snapshot and confirm retention policy.

lin: Snapshot taken at 1717772500 (s3://prod-snapshots/mig-enc-token-v3-1717772500). Backups good.

maya: Let's ensure alerting: pager if errors>1% for 5m or if replication lag>1000ms.

migwatch-bot: Canary finished at 1717772560. Results: row_processed=12.1k, errors=0, avg_latency=18ms. No alerts.

lin: Going to ramp to all small tenants at 1717772570. If anyone sees anything odd say now.

josh: Watching. If errors spike, set users.encrypt_mig_pause and I'll trigger rollback.

maya: ACK. I'll update release notes and docs.

deploybot: ramp started at 1717772579. Good luck :rocket: 

lin: Thanks team. Post-mortem notes: capture perf and error metrics, add runbook step to avoid eviction when mem pressure spikes.
